item.title: Scrap 0.4.0
item.description:
# Scrap v0.4.0 (build 8)
**Update Scrap on all your devices.** Scrap for iOS 0.4.0 ships alongside this release, and both work best at the same version.
This release shows you where synced text lands, adds line times, and makes Scrap keep itself up to date from now on.
## See what arrived
- **A green bar marks text that synced from another device**, beside the lines it changed. It stays for about 4 seconds once you can actually see it, then fades. Text that arrives while the panel is closed, scrolled out of view or on another day's tab keeps its bar until you look, and a bar you only glimpsed finishes its few seconds when you come back. - Lines added together get one bar: the bars follow the line times, so a block that shows one time has one bar. - Text Scrap pastes for you from your clipboard (Settings › **Paste recent copies when opening**) gets a blue bar.
## Line times
- **Swipe left with two fingers** (or scroll sideways with a mouse) to slide the page and see when each line was added, or `edited` and when. Let go and it springs back. - **Hold Option** to show the times over the text without sliding it. - A block typed in one minute shows one time, at its top. Blank lines get none.
## Typing and sync
- **Synced text waits while you type.** If a change arrives while you're mid-sentence, Scrap applies it once you pause, and your cursor stays where you were typing. - Scrap now saves your typing half a second after you stop, rather than on every keystroke, and keeps a copy of every keystroke meanwhile, so nothing is lost if it quits. - Fixed: if two devices created the same day's note at the same moment, an edit made on one of them straight afterwards could, rarely, be dropped.
## Updates
- **Scrap now updates itself.** It checks for a new version about once a day. If you're busy, a dot appears on the menu-bar icon and a notification tells you an update is ready. You can also choose **Check for Updates…** from the menu-bar icon's menu, and turn automatic checks off in Settings. - Updates come from this version on: this one you install by hand, as before. - **Keep Scrap in your Applications folder.** Opened from anywhere else, such as Downloads, Scrap asks you to move it there, because it can only update itself from Applications. Drag it into Applications, then open it from there.
## Known issues
- With three or more devices typing in the same note at once, a line can occasionally appear twice. Nothing is lost. - Rarely, if two devices tidy up the same duplicated day at the same moment, a line you deleted can come back. Nothing is lost.
